nodes.label: Racks — physical rack elevations (/racks)
nodes.rationale: used_u/height_u bar counts front and rear gear sharing a U once.

nodes.label: SVG rack elevation with Front/Rear toggle
nodes.rationale: Read-only SVG, U1 at the bottom; front and rear devices legitimately share U slots so each view draws only its own face plus both-face gear like shelves.

nodes.label: Health overlay — scan-status dots on device blocks
nodes.rationale: On by default and remembered per browser; dots reuse the address-table status colors so rack health matches live scan data at a glance (green=active, amber=reserved, cyan=dhcp, violet=discovered, zinc=offline, grey=unmonitored).

nodes.label: Next-free-U finder (lowest/highest contiguous span, face-aware)
nodes.rationale: Face-aware: asks the API for the lowest or highest contiguous span fitting the entered height on the chosen face, so a front device may legally sit opposite rear gear in the same U.

nodes.label: Placement & collision rules (u_position bottom-up)
nodes.rationale: Front+rear in the same U is fine because a cabinet has two faces; front+front (or rear+rear) is rejected with a conflict error, and a both-face device conflicts with anything overlapping its span. Devices can't extend above height_u.

nodes.label: Rackula round-trip (share URL, .Rackula.zip, merge/replace import)
nodes.rationale: IpamBox round-trips with a self-hosted Rackula instance instead of re-implementing a drag-and-drop editor; carrier-mounted or sub-U gear has no IpamBox equivalent and is skipped on import. Imported devices carry a rackula source badge.

nodes.label: Print report — /racks/[id]/print
nodes.rationale: Paper-friendly report with rack metadata, front and rear elevations side by side, and a full device table (U range, face, type, linked asset and IP + status); save as PDF via the browser print dialog.

nodes.label: QR dialog & /racks/[id]/label sticker
nodes.rationale: QR points at the rack's live elevation URL; the minimal sticker card (QR + name + URL) is sized for a physical label so you can stick it on the rack and scan to open the live view. Same QR appears in the print report footer.
